Package org.apache.beam.sdk

Class Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.Defaults

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.Defaults
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pipeline.PipelineVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
CountingPipelineVisitor, GroupByKeyVisitor, LookupPipelineVisitor, SparkRunner.Evaluator, Twister2PipelineTranslator
Enclosing interface:
Pipeline.PipelineVisitor
public static class Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.Defaults extends Object implements Pipeline.PipelineVisitor
Default no-op Pipeline.PipelineVisitor that enters all composite transforms. User implementations can override just those methods they are interested in.
